name: Desvenlaxafine 50mg 14 Extended-Release Tablets (Generic)
description: Desvenlafaxine 50 mg, 14 extended-release tablets, is a generic medication that belongs to a class of antidepressants known as serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors (SNRIs). It is primarily used to treat major depressive disorder (MDD) in adults. The extended-release formulation allows the medication to be released slowly into the body, helping to maintain stable levels throughout the day.
